verdict.rationale: Square is a payments, point-of-sale and commerce API platform, not an AI agent or host application. Consuming third-party MCP servers (the MCP client role) is outside this product category. The documented Square MCP server is the opposite role: it exposes Square's tools to other agents and does not let Square use tools from other MCP servers, so it does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
